headline: Q2FY27: Strive Towards Premiumisation & Diversification; Presales In Line

highlights: During H1FY27, the company generated an operating cash surplus of Rs 480 Cr, which management expects to scale up to between Rs 1,200 Cr and Rs 1,500 Cr by the end of the year as major projects reach completion.
The company reported a healthy Adjusted Gross Profit margin of 31.0% and an Adjusted EBITDA margin of 13.1% for H1FY27.
Addressing potential cost pressures, management noted that historical construction cost escalations are contained within the late single digits and are not expected to cross into double digits.

Sector Outlook: Positive Company Outlook & Guidance: Management remains confident in the sustained demand across the NCR and broader Gurugram residential market, supported by infrastructure development and healthy price appreciation, with the NCR witnessing the fastest price rise among India's top cities at 12%.
valuation: For FY27, Signature Global has firmly reaffirmed its target for project launches of Rs 15,000 Cr and pre-sales of Rs 10,000 Cr, alongside customer collections and revenue recognition guidance of Rs 5,000 Cr each.

Current Valuation: 3x FY28E EV/EBITDA (Earlier 3.5x FY28E Pre-sales/EBITDA) Current TP: Rs 880/share (Earlier TP: Rs 1,010/share) Recommendation: We now value the company using an EV/EBITDA framework and have moderated the bookings growth assumption for FY28E to reflect a maturing Gurugram market.
Based on a 3x FY28E valuation, we arrive at a target price of Rs 880/share, implying an upside of 17% from the CMP.
